The vendor directly providing the software and services at **npmjs.com** (product: **Npm**) is **npm, Inc.**

### Provider Statement & Evidence
According to the official **npm Open-Source Terms** (governing access to and use of `https://www.npmjs.com` and the npm Public Registry at `https://registry.npmjs.org`):
> *"These npm Open Source terms of use (these Terms) govern access to and use of https://www.npmjs.com (the Website) as well as the 'npm Public Registry' at https://registry.npmjs.org (the Public Registry). npm, Inc. (npm) operates each of those services."*

Similarly, the **npm Paid Services Terms** confirm that services at `https://www.npmjs.com` are offered and contracted by **npm, Inc.**
